set.body:
Goal
Test whether Transport v3 recovers the relationships it claims to model before any new behavioral association is examined.

Court
Factor contraction, translation, spatial noise, duration heterogeneity, global time dilation, local swaps, block reordering, reversal, deletion, insertion, central bias, fixation count, candidate difficulty, and coherent short subsequences. Include same-density/destroyed-sequence and same-sequence/contracted-geometry cells.

Comparators
Transport v2, stabilized Replay, registered density and density sigma 80/160, raw MultiMatch dimensions, and a ridge-regularized learned MultiMatch composite trained in the same nested folds.

Acceptance criteria
- Representation invariance covers split/merge, units, candidate order, batch size, and coverage-grid refinement.
- Registration does not improve wrong candidates more than true candidates under the frozen null gate.
- Harmless timing dilation is stable; chronology destruction at fixed density is detected; partial coherent replay yields intermediate evidence.
- Methods use identical support, candidates, folds, priors, and uncertainty resamples.
- Report item information, log loss, calibration, identification/rank, power at matched false-positive rate, failure rate, runtime, and memory.
- The court writes a machine-readable manifest and bounded pass/fail ledger. Failure triggers algorithm revision before study or retrieval scoring, not threshold relaxation.
set.title: GW-18.8 Run the frozen invariance, perturbation, and performance court
